001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.util.EnumMap;
004import java.util.Map;
005import java.util.Objects;
006import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
007import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogEncoder.EncoderProvider;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputType;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5FormatterBuilder;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.LogfmtFormatterBuilder;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLLFormatterBuilder;
017
018/**
019 * Encoder registry. Only one encoder is registered by default which has the URI schema of
020 * {@value TTLL#SCHEMA} and is used if no encoder is found for the {@link OutputType} of
021 * the resolved output.
022 */
023public sealed interface LogEncoderRegistry extends EncoderProvider {
024
025        /**
026         * Registers an encoder by uri scheme.
027         * @param scheme encoder name.
028         * @param encoder loaded encoder
029         */
030        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder);
031
032        /**
033         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type.
034         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
035         * @return formatter for output type.
036         */
037        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType);
038
039        /**
040         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
041         * @param outputType output type.
042         * @param formatter formatter.
043         */
044        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter);
045
046}
047
048final class DefaultEncoderRegistry implements LogEncoderRegistry {
049
050        /*
051         * The logfmt encoder's URI scheme.
052         */
053        static final String LOGFMT_SCHEME = "logfmt";
054
055        /*
056         * The core JSON5 encoder's URI scheme.
057         */
058        static final String JSON5_SCHEME = "json5";
059
060        private final Map<String, EncoderProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
061
062        /**
063         * Creates encoder registry
064         * @return encoder registry
065         */
066        public static LogEncoderRegistry of() {
067                var registry = new DefaultEncoderRegistry();
068                registry.register(TTLL.SCHEMA,
069                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
070                                        .of(ttll(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
071                                        .provide(name, config));
072                registry.register(LOGFMT_SCHEME,
073                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
074                                        .of(logfmt(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
075                                        .provide(name, config));
076                registry.register(JSON5_SCHEME,
077                                ref -> (name, config) -> LogEncoder
078                                        .of(json5(name, config).fromProperties(config.properties(), ref).build())
079                                        .provide(name, config));
080                return registry;
081        }
082
083        @Override
084        public LogProvider<LogEncoder> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
085                var _ref = DefaultLogProviderRef.normalize(ref);
086                var uri = _ref.uri();
087                /*
088                 * TODO file bug with checker as it should have found scheme to be null.
089                 */
090                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
091                if (scheme == null) {
092                        throw new IllegalStateException("bug. uri was not normalized");
093                }
094
095                var provider = providers.get(scheme);
096                if (provider == null) {
097                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.ENCODER, scheme, uri,
098                                        providers.keySet());
099                }
100
101                return provider.provide(_ref);
102        }
103
104        @Override
105        public void register(String scheme, EncoderProvider encoder) {
106                /*
107                 * TODO maybe check if one is already registered and do something?
108                 */
109                providers.put(scheme, encoder);
110        }
111
112        private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
113
114        private final EnumMap<OutputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder>> formatters = new EnumMap<>(OutputType.class);
115
116        /*
117         * Builders for the coloring formatters that honor the global ANSI mode: it sets the
118         * default color mode, while an explicit color property still wins.
119         */
120        static TTLLFormatterBuilder ttll(String name, LogConfig config) {
121                var b = new TTLLFormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
122                var color = colorMode(config);
123                if (color != null) {
124                        b.color(color);
125                }
126                return b;
127        }
128
129        static LogfmtFormatterBuilder logfmt(String name, LogConfig config) {
130                var b = new LogfmtFormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
131                var color = colorMode(config);
132                if (color != null) {
133                        b.color(color);
134                }
135                return b;
136        }
137
138        static Json5FormatterBuilder json5(String name, LogConfig config) {
139                var b = new Json5FormatterBuilder(name).serviceRegistry(config.serviceRegistry());
140                var color = colorMode(config);
141                if (color != null) {
142                        b.color(color);
143                }
144                return b;
145        }
146
147        private static TTLL.@Nullable ColorMode colorMode(LogConfig config) {
148                return switch (config.globals().ansiMode()) {
149                        case AUTO -> null;
150                        case ON -> TTLL.ColorMode.FORCE;
151                        case OFF -> TTLL.ColorMode.OFF;
152                };
153        }
154
155        /**
156         * Associates a default formatter with a specific output type
157         * @param outputType output type to use for finding best default formatter.
158         * @return encoder for output type.
159         */
160        @Override
161        public LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> encoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
162                lock.readLock().lock();
163                try {
164                        var formatter = formatters.get(outputType);
165                        if (formatter == null) {
166                                if (outputType == OutputType.CONSOLE_OUT || outputType == OutputType.CONSOLE_ERR) {
167                                        return LogEncoder.ofTTLL();
168                                }
169                                /*
170                                 * Never color a file or other non console output unless asked: ANSI
171                                 * detection only knows about the console.
172                                 */
173                                return (name, config) -> LogEncoder
174                                        .of(ttll(name, config).color(TTLL.ColorMode.OFF).fromProperties(config.properties()).build())
175                                        .provide(name, config);
176                        }
177                        return Objects.requireNonNull(formatter);
178                }
179                finally {
180                        lock.readLock().unlock();
181                }
182        }
183
184        /**
185         * Sets a default formatter for a specific output type.
186         * @param outputType output type.
187         * @param formatter formatter.
188         */
189        @Override
190        public void setEncoderForOutputType(OutputType outputType, LogProvider<? extends LogEncoder> formatter) {
191                lock.writeLock().lock();
192                try {
193                        formatters.put(outputType, formatter);
194                }
195                finally {
196                        lock.writeLock().unlock();
197                }
198        }
199
200}
